title: Etale and Zariski cohomology of quasi-coherent modules agree, naturally in the module
statement:
Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $X_{\Et}$ its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-etale-site]. For a quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-module $\mathcal F$ [pqf-def-coherent] let $\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}}\in\Ab(X_{\Et})$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves] be the associated etale sheaf $u\mapsto\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)$ of [def-sc-etale-qcoherent-module], and for an $\mathcal O_X$-linear morphism $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ of quasi-coherent $\mathcal O_X$-modules [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] let $\varphi_{\mathrm{et}}:\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}}\to\mathcal G_{\mathrm{et}}$ be given on an object $u:U\to X$ of $X_{\Et}$ by $\Gamma(U,u^*\varphi):\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal F)\to\Gamma(U,u^*\mathcal G)$, where $u^*$ is the pullback of modules [def-pc-module-pullback]. Then $\varphi_{\mathrm{et}}$ is a morphism of $\Ab(X_{\Et})$, and there are isomorphisms of abelian groups
$$
c^q_{\mathcal F}:H^q(X,\mathcal F)\xrightarrow{\ \sim\ }H^q(X_{\Et},\mathcal F_{\mathrm{et}})\qquad(q\geq0),
$$
the left side the cohomology of $\mathcal F$ on $X$ [pqf-def-cohomology], the right side etale cohomology [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology], with $c^0_{\mathcal F}$ the identity of $\Gamma(X,\mathcal F)$, such that for every $\mathcal O_X$-linear $\varphi:\mathcal F\to\mathcal G$ of quasi-coherent modules and every $q\geq0$
$$
c^q_{\mathcal G}\circ H^q(X,\varphi)=H^q(X_{\Et},\varphi_{\mathrm{et}})\circ c^q_{\mathcal F}.
$$

proof.text: Construct m with component evaluation of tensorPullback.map phi. Prove section-unit naturality from the pullback adjunction unit and the module-map presheaf naturality. Combine this with naturality of tensorSectionsComp and of equality transport to prove compatibility with every etale restriction. Hence these components form an actual abelian sheaf morphism.

For q=n+1, compose the additive equivalence given by the component of zariskiModuleAbelianCohomologyAgree with etaleZariskiAbelianPositiveComparison applied to the constructed m. Evaluation of the first natural isomorphism's naturality equation, followed by the new theorem's naturality equation, proves naturality of this composite.

In degree zero use the right-derived-zero isomorphism of the left-exact module global-sections functor. The structure morphism a of the chosen terminal etale object is an isomorphism, by comparing this terminal object with id_X. Pushforward along a is an equivalence, so the unit of tensorPullback a adjoint to pushforward a is an isomorphism. Evaluation and the preimage-top restriction give an additive equivalence tensorSectionsUnit a F on global sections. Compose the right-derived-zero equivalence, this unit, and the inverse of Sheaf.H.equiv_0. Naturalities of these three maps prove degree-zero naturality. The cancellation of toRightDerivedZero with rightDerivedZeroIsoSelf and the cancellation of equiv_0 with its inverse give exactly the prescribed unit value on every section. Finally combine zero and positive degrees by Nat.casesOn, simultaneously for every quasi-coherent module.
